style: Vertical 9:16 portrait. Flat 2D vector animation in a clean modern explainer style: simple flat shapes, no outlines, soft warm peach, cream and terracotta colours, characters with round heads and simple friendly faces, smooth gentle motion, plain background shapes.

chars.ROHAN: ROHAN: Indian father, about 35, short black hair, short light beard, blue t-shirt, dark grey trousers.
chars.ANANYA: ANANYA: Indian mother, about 32, long black hair tied back, orange kurta with a cream dupatta across one shoulder, dark trousers.
chars.KABIR: KABIR: Indian boy, about 7, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, blue shorts.
chars.PRIYA: PRIYA: young Indian hotel receptionist, neat bun, maroon blazer over a white shirt.
chars.CHEF: CHEF: Indian hotel chef, about 40, round face, small moustache, white chef jacket and white chef cap.

clips.speaker: ROHAN
clips.scene: A red car parked in front of a cream two-storey hotel with a plain dark green sign board (no letters) and round green trees. The family steps out of the car with a suitcase; Rohan stretches, smiles at Ananya and Kabir
clips.line: Lambi drive thi... bas ab check-in jaldi ho jaaye!

clips.speaker: PRIYA
clips.scene: A hotel reception desk with a laptop. Priya stands behind the desk, the family stands in front. Priya taps the laptop, then smiles and hands Rohan a small card
clips.line: Swagat hai! Do minute mein aapka check-in ho gaya. Yeh rahi aapki guest code.

clips.speaker: ANANYA
clips.scene: A cosy hotel room with a bed, orange curtains and a window. Ananya sits on the bed holding a phone; Kabir bounces on the bed. Ananya taps her phone and smiles
clips.line: Kabir ko doodh chahiye... main phone se hi order kar deti hoon. Ho gaya!

clips.speaker: CHEF
clips.scene: A clean hotel kitchen with a tablet screen on the wall. The chef looks at the tablet, nods, and picks up a tray with a glass of milk and two cups of tea
clips.line: Room do sau chaar, ek doodh, do chai. Abhi bhejta hoon!

clips.speaker: KABIR
clips.scene: The hotel room door opens and a smiling waiter in a white shirt and black vest holds a tray with a glass of milk and two cups of tea. Kabir runs to the door, excited, and turns back towards his mother
clips.line: Mumma, order aa gaya! Itni jaldi?

clips.speaker: ROHAN
clips.scene: On the hotel room balcony at sunset, Rohan sits in a chair sipping tea, relaxed, looking at the camera with a big smile
clips.line: Na line, na baar baar phone... is hotel mein sab kitna aasaan hai!
